scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env electron_config_cache=.electron-cache VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && bun run build:runtime && bun run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsc --ignoreConfig --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --types node,electron --outDir dist-electron electron/main.ts electron/agentBridge.ts electron/providerConfigStore.ts electron/runtimeClient.ts electron/runtimeProcess.ts electron/workspaceBridge.ts electron/windowPolicy.ts electron/navigationPolicy.ts shared/desktopApi.ts && bun build electron/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.package:win: bun run build && cross-env electron_config_cache=.electron-cache electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.package:mac: bun run build && cross-env electron_config_cache=.electron-cache electron-builder --mac dmg
